sage.note: Sage differentiates repeatedly by taking the variable and the count as separate arguments, diff(f, x, 2); the {x, 2} pair is read as a list of variables and refused.

caption: $\frac{d}{dz}\Phi(z, 2, 1)$ lands on logarithm and dilogarithm terms, where compute-engine leaves it as a combination of $\Phi$ itself
sympy.note: SymPy leaves the derivative in LerchPhi, (Φ(z, 1, 1) - Φ(z, 2, 1))/z; ours writes both terms in closed form, since Φ(z, 1, 1) = -ln(1 - z)/z and Φ(z, 2, 1) = Li₂(z)/z. The two are equal.
